purpose: Capture a recent primary NIA survey lead for inland freshwater ecosystems in Bayombong and Bambang, Nueva Vizcaya, while keeping the proposed irrigation project, fish collection, water-quality baseline and public occurrence data distinct.

project.name: Magapuy-Paitan Integrated National Irrigation Project (INIP)
project.agency: National Irrigation Administration, Nueva Vizcaya Irrigation Management Office, Region II
project.statusAsReported: The 2026 page describes the project as proposed and at pre-feasibility study stage; later project status was not verified.
administrativeLocalities: Barangay San Fernando, Bambang, Nueva Vizcaya

methodsAsReported: May 28 phase: nets used to collect baseline data on the aquatic environment.
June 11 phase: fish species collected using traditional traps.
limits: The notice says that further investigations were planned but provides no final survey report.
No fish names, identification method, effort, station-level results, collection coordinates, voucher numbers or taxon-to-station crosswalk are given.
This confirms that fish collection was reported, not which taxa were present or absent.

waterQualityBaseline.purpose: Pre-feasibility baseline water-quality analysis before proposed irrigation development.

stationLeads.context: Drainage creek of the proposed Magapuy-Paitan INIP irrigation canal.
Water-quality monitoring station; exact reach and coordinates not published.
The source labels an intake area; no separate waterbody boundary or exact reach is given.
Station is associated with Barangay San Fernando, Bambang; exact waterbody reach and coordinates are not published.

limits: The NIA notice says samples would undergo laboratory testing but does not provide values or a completed report.
This is not a current water-quality or human-safety finding.
The station names are leads, not validated hydrographic features, precise sampling localities, or reusable geometry.

identityAndGeometry.administrativeCrosswalk: The 2026 NIA notice names Paitan and Magapuy in Bayombong and San Fernando in Bambang. No station coordinates or reach boundaries were published.
identityAndGeometry.projectWaterbodyStatus: The source discusses water sources and local rivers/streams associated with a proposed irrigation project; no new reservoir or canal completion is inferred.

nextAction: Seek NIA-NVIMO's completed freshwater ecology survey and laboratory report, with taxon determinations, dates, methods, vouchers or photos, station-to-waterbody crosswalk and coordinates. Separately confirm current project status and obtain written reuse terms before any public use. Keep the 2025 fish survey, 2026 water-quality sampling, proposed irrigation works and any future species/geometry rows separate.

sources.supports: NIA Region II reports 2025 net sampling in May and fish collection with traditional traps in June at Barangays Magapuy and Paitan; no fish taxa or findings are published in the notice.
NIA Region II reports February 27, 2026 pre-feasibility water sampling at four named monitoring-station areas; no test results, coordinates or geometry are published in the notice.
